headline: Free Grapeseed Clubhouse, GTA$1M challenge and Biker bonuses
quickTake: Claim the FREE Grapeseed Clubhouse via Maze Bank Foreclosures by September 16 — no GTA+ required.
Sell GTA$1M of MC Business or Acid Lab product for an extra GTA$1M and the Junk Tracksuit by September 16.
2X GTA$ on Street Dealer Sales and Bike Service Missions; Bike Service pays 6X for GTA+ members.
Karin S95 is 70% off on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC Enhanced.

GTA+ only: September benefits confirmed against Rockstar on September 15; valid September 10–October 7 unless a shorter period is stated.
GTA+ only: claim the Pegassi Horus for free at The Vinewood Car Club with the Velvet Iris livery, through October 7. Early access ends September 16; general sale begins September 17.
GTA+ only: 2X GTA$ on your first weekly completion of the Cluckin’ Bell Farm Raid finale, Scene of the Crime, September 10–October 7. No extra RP multiplier is announced.
GTA+ only: 2X Cocaine Lockup production speed, September 10–October 7. This offer does not announce a Nightclub production bonus.

GTA+ only: Bike Service Missions pay 3X GTA$ and RP through October 7; the GTA$ reward is increased to 6X during September 10–16. Clubhouse Custom Bike Shop required.

beginnerPath.label: Claim the free Grapeseed Clubhouse through Maze Bank Foreclosures by September 16. The Custom Bike Shop is a separate purchase.
Play Community Mission Series for 3X GTA$ & RP on PS5, Xbox Series X|S or PC Enhanced; use the Community Series marker in Legion Square.
Use the Clubhouse meeting-room contracts for 2X GTA$ & RP. Bike Service Missions require the Custom Bike Shop.
If you own an MC Business or Acid Lab, sell GTA$1M worth of its product for the GTA$1M Weekly Challenge prize and Junk Tracksuit by September 16. Track the challenge in the Interaction Menu.
